_comment: Copy to runner/config.json (gitignored) and fill real values. dryRun:true writes events to state/events.jsonl and reads inbox from state/inbox.json - no network needed.

deepseek._comment: Switchable second provider (OpenAI-compatible). The API key is read from runner/deepseek.key (gitignored) - NOT stored here. A missing key file simply makes DeepSeek unavailable. Default model is V4-Flash, the cheaper of the two.
deepseek._fx_comment: GBP per 1 USD. ASSUMPTION - a fixed rate so model spend and electricity spend share one currency and can sit on the same chart. Update as the rate moves.

prices._comment: USD per MILLION tokens. Verified from DeepSeek's rate card, July 2026. Kept in config so a price change needs no code change. RE-CHECK periodically - provider prices change.
